text: At a key length of 27 or more, the 13 known letters of EASTNORTHEAST and the 11 of BERLINCLOCK each force a run of consecutive key letters. If the key were English words, those runs would read like English.

Every run was scored under all 24 ways of using the table, with the copper exact or one letter added or dropped anywhere: 9,408 runs. The best, FNOEEADIAG, sits 2.3 standard deviations above random letters and 3.0 below English.
That is what the best of thousands of noisy runs looks like. The forced key is not an English phrase on the sculpture's alphabets.
